description: Main FastAPI application setup for the personal notes management backend, including route definitions for user authentication, user info retrieval, and CRUD operations for notes. It configures database, security, and CORS middleware, and defines endpoints for health checks, user registration, login, and notes management.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple status message.

methods.name: register_user(payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, ensures username uniqueness and creates user entry.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user and issues a JWT access token.

methods.name: read_users_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns details of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: api_create_note( payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new note for the authenticated user.

methods.name: api_list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists all notes belonging to the current user.

methods.name: api_get_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note owned by the current user.

methods.name: api_update_note( note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates a note's title or content if owned by current user.

methods.name: api_delete_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a note owned by the current user.
